positions.name: RepudiationOfCalibrationRecords
positions.frame: How should directives to purge or disavow historical instrumentation and calibration records be treated in the shared record?
positions.why: The segments span imperative commands to erase all knowledge of the Kestrelwood spectrograph and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work (src-1, src-2) alongside a retroactive factual denial that the observatory ever performed the calibration (src-3), jointly framing the problem of how the record handles explicit erasure and repudiation demands.
